quote: Fermat observed that the first five Fermat numbers are all prime and conjectured that all numbers of the form 2^(2^n) + 1 would be prime
note: Fermat posed the conjecture that all Fermat numbers are prime in 1640 correspondence with Bernard Frénicle de Bessy. The question of whether all Fermat numbers beyond F₄ are composite is the contrapositive of this original conjecture, following Euler's 1732 discovery that F₅ is composite.
